title: wahlenbergia gracilis var. littoralis
intro: Wahlenbergia gracilis var. littoralis, commonly known as coastal bluebells, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Campanulaceae family. It is native to coastal regions and is often used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The plant is said to have therapeutic actions such as reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and supporting immune function. Research has identified various bioactive constituents in coastal bluebells, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
